answer: Audits are entered in quill, queued in vault, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 286 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 23 identities per epoch. A farm of 1476 identities would post 2185 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
